title: compute: real AlphaFold2-multimer ipTM >= 0.5 for binder vs target (Challenge 2 gate)
claim: A designed binder achieves predicted ipTM >= 0.5 against the target (multimer v3, single-sequence MSA).
ceiling: ipTM is an in-silico prediction, NOT a wet-lab binding result. It does not establish folding, solubility, or on-target binding in the lab. Does not compare track/selection standing.

provenance.notes: dry-run mode validates the gate with bounding logic; swap to real mode (no --dry-run) only when factory has yielded the GPU.
